title: WCSB Egress: The Takeaway Stack, Rail and the Diluent Import Legs
dek: Egress stands at 5,069 kb/d (4,984 kb/d of crude pipes on the proven-floor basis plus 85 kb/d of economic rail) against 4,865 kb/d of marketable supply in the current balance's October 2026, a +204 kb/d spare that the Trans Mountain and Mainline expansions widen through 2027 and 2028. The Mainline carries about three fifths of the pipe stack on an all-spot basis; the committed pipes (Trans Mountain, Keystone) are the contracted core; and the two inbound condensate legs are drawn because diluent supply and egress economics are one picture.
